narr: Storms developed during the afternoon and early evening as a very moist and unstable air mass interacted with upper level energy and an approaching cold front. The strongest storms developed during the early and mid-afternoon of the 29th, producing sporadic wind damage and torrential rainfall across the southern half of the area. Parts of Springfield received over three inches of rain within a period of around one to two hours. This produced flash flooding in Springfield, Nixa and Marshfield. Wind damage was also|reported with storms over south central and southwest Missouri.
